fields.title: Analyze Threats
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Feature: customers leave product photos in reviews. Find five threats by category and propose solutions.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: disclosure — documents, faces, address accidentally end up in the photo; solution: warning, moderation, stripping geolocation metadata. Tampering — uploading a malicious file disguised as an image; file type check and re-compression. Denial of service — uploading huge files; size and count limits. Disclosure — EXIF metadata contains shooting coordinates; mandatory deletion. Privilege escalation — file path allows guessing others'; unguessable identifiers. A key finding is usually EXIF: the buyer's home coordinates in a public review.
